items.title: Automate 2026 brings humanoid robotics to the spotlight in Chicago
items.summary: North America's largest automation show returns to Chicago's McCormick Place on June 22-25 with 1,000+ exhibitors, AI-focused keynotes, and an NVIDIA-sponsored Humanoid Robot Pavilion featuring more than 20 humanoids.

items.title: Figure 03 production hits one robot per hour as Boston Dynamics Atlas deployments begin
items.summary: Figure AI's BotQ factory has reached a build rate of one Figure 03 per hour, while Boston Dynamics' electric Atlas starts its first deployments — with 2026 units committed to Hyundai and Google DeepMind.

items.title: Rivian CEO's Mind Robotics raises over $1 billion for humanoids
items.summary: RJ Scaringe's separate humanoid venture, Mind Robotics, has raised more than $1 billion and expects to reveal its first product within a year, with Rivian as a major shareholder and launch customer.

items.title: China targets 10,000 humanoid robot deployments by end of 2026
items.summary: A new government program directs Chinese provinces to put humanoid robots to work across factories, hospitals, logistics centres and emergency response, aiming for 10,000 real-world deployments by year end.

items.title: Investors bet humanoid robots will transform industry and homes
items.summary: Capital is flowing into physical AI as Unitree opens Asia's first embodied-intelligence store in Shanghai; SoftBank's Masayoshi Son calls robotics the source of the next trillion-dollar company, with forecasts of 100-fold growth.

items.title: Japan Airlines deploys humanoids at Haneda as BMW's Figure pilot scales
items.summary: JAL began a three-year humanoid deployment at Tokyo's Haneda Airport, while BMW reported its Figure 02 robots helped build over 30,000 vehicles at Spartanburg before expanding the program to its Leipzig plant in Europe.

items.title: Humanoid Robot Forum returns to Automate 2026
items.summary: The June 23-24 forum gathers leaders from Boston Dynamics, Neura Robotics, NVIDIA and Toyota Research Institute to tackle a shifting question: not whether humanoids work, but what it takes to run them safely at scale.

items.title: Unitree Robotics' IPO accepted for Shanghai's STAR Market
items.summary: Unitree's IPO application has been accepted for Shanghai's STAR Market, positioning the fast-growing, profitable maker of quadrupeds and humanoids — which shipped 5,500+ robots in 2025 — for a public listing.
